name: fuze
description: FUZE agent tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: fuze
plugins.description: Read the FUZE agent's status, open its local page (`fuze ui`), and reduce its risk (pause, flatten, lower limits). Starts the command `fuze`, as installed with `uv tool install` or `pipx install` from https://github.com/robert-schmidt/fuze; `fuze mcp-config` prints the settings for any other install.
